theme.mode: light/dark dual mode with tactical field engineering aesthetic

color_palette.archetype: The Performance Pro (Tactical Minimalism for Construction Field)

layouts.header: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shrink-0
layouts.main_content: flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-24 pt-4 px-4 custom-scrollbar
layouts.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-[72px] bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-around items-center px-2 z-50 pb-safe shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
layouts.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-4 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform
layouts.fab: fixed bottom-24 right-4 w-14 h-14 bg-[#D97706] rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center text-white z-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform

mobile_patterns.navigation: Replace sidebar with Bottom Navigation Bar (Home, Projects, Reports, Issues, Assistant). Move Team/Profile to Header avatar dropdown.
mobile_patterns.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all interactive elements to support gloved hands on site.
mobile_patterns.forms: Vertical stacks only. No side-by-side inputs on mobile. Native HTML5 date/time pickers where Shadcn is too complex for touch.
mobile_patterns.gestures: Swipeable list items for quick actions (e.g., swipe right to approve, left to reject).
mobile_patterns.offline_sync: Visual indicators for sync status (green dot = synced, amber = offline/pending) in header.

motion.interactions: active:scale-[0.98] on cards and buttons for physical feedback
motion.page_transitions: Slide up for modals/bottom sheets. No complex page transitions to maintain performance.

component_strategy.framework: React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/UI (heavily customized for mobile touch)
component_strategy.styling: Tactical Minimalism: Flat solid surfaces, 1px strong borders, high contrast badges, no soft glassmorphism in data areas (to prevent glare).
component_strategy.modals: Use Bottom Sheets (Drawer component) instead of center Dialogs for mobile ergonomics.
component_strategy.tables: Convert data tables to Card Lists. Never use horizontal scrolling tables on mobile.
component_strategy.charts: Recharts with responsive containers, simplified axes, and touch-to-scrub tooltips.

accessibility.contrast_standards: High contrast for outdoor daylight visibility. Avoid light grey text.
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive elements must have aria-labels and data-testid attributes

image_urls.description: Workers discussing plans on a sandy construction site with safety gear

instructions_to_main_agent: Re-architect App.css, civic.css, and Shell.jsx for mobile-first PWA execution.
Replace .sidebar with a fixed .bottom-nav using Flexbox. Ensure active states have high contrast.
Convert .main-area to take full width and handle vertical scrolling with `padding-bottom` to prevent content overlap with the bottom nav.
Change .kpi-grid and .dashboard-grid to mobile layouts (e.g., grid-cols-2 for small KPIs, full width for charts).
Transform complex data rows (.project-row, .activity-row, .record-row) into stacked mobile cards (flex-col, gap-2). Remove desktop table headers.
Add Bottom Sheet/Drawer patterns for complex filters, exports, and forms instead of standard center modals.
Increase button and list item padding to ensure 44px minimum tap target height. Add `pb-safe` for mobile safe areas.
Apply 'The Performance Pro' color strategy: High contrast backgrounds with #D97706 highlights and pure white text for maximum readability outdoors.
Add floating action buttons (FAB) for primary creation actions per tab (e.g., Add Issue, Add Report).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully (only in headers/navs, never on data cards). DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - active states (scale down), transitions.
Use generous spacing (p-4 to p-6). Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
